```{r}
#| label: setup

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
library(tidymodels)
library(here)
library(readr)

set.seed(123)

source(here("shared", "02_preprocessing.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: qwk-metric
qwk <- metric_tweak("qwk", kap, weighting = "quadratic")
grade_metrics <- metric_set(qwk, accuracy, f_meas, roc_auc)
```

## Model

```{r}
#| label: model-spec
multinomial_spec <- multinom_reg() |>
  set_engine("nnet") |>
  set_mode("classification")

log_reg_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_model(multinomial_spec) |>
  add_recipe(base_recipe)
```

## Cross-validation

```{r}
#| label: cv-fit
set.seed(123)
log_reg_resamples <- fit_resamples(
  log_reg_workflow,
  resamples = folds,
  metrics = grade_metrics,
  control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
)

collect_metrics(log_reg_resamples)
```

## Final fit

```{r}
#| label: final-fit
log_reg_last_fit <- last_fit(
  log_reg_workflow,
  eq_split,
  metrics = grade_metrics
)

collect_metrics(log_reg_last_fit)
```

```{r}
#| label: test-predictions
test_pred <- collect_predictions(log_reg_last_fit)

conf_mat(test_pred, damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)
```

```{r}
#| label: per-class
# One-vs-rest precision, recall, and F1 for each damage grade, computed
# directly from the confusion matrix (yardstick's precision()/recall()/
# f_meas() only return macro-averaged values for multiclass outcomes).
cm_tbl <- conf_mat(test_pred, damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)$table

map_dfr(rownames(cm_tbl), function(cls) {
  tp <- cm_tbl[cls, cls]
  fp <- sum(cm_tbl[cls, ]) - tp
  fn <- sum(cm_tbl[, cls]) - tp
  precision <- tp / (tp + fp)
  recall <- tp / (tp + fn)
  tibble(
    class = cls,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    f_meas = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
  )
})
```

## Save results

```{r}
#| label: save-results
#| include: false
dir.create(here("results", "models"), showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(
  extract_workflow(log_reg_last_fit),
  here("results", "models", "chang_multinomial_logistic.rds")
)
```
